OWNER DECISION applied by rev 27: decide() takes a CLOSED, VERSIONED PER-REALM EVIDENCE SCHEMA. Permissive property access is removed. A realm record must carry EXACTLY the 11 required own keys in canonical order (schemaVersion, id, mechanism, measurable, error, timedOut, typeofSharedWorker, descriptor, nativeCtor, constructed, repetitionsConsistent), every value validated against an exact type or enumeration, absence expressed by NAMED STRING SENTINELS (error:'none', descriptor:'absent', nativeCtor:'absent'). ABSENCE OF A FIELD IS ALWAYS UNVERIFIED. mechanism, error and descriptor are explicitly required.

Order of operations is normative: structural inspection of the caller's input -> inert snapshot (JSON round-trip) -> freeze -> schema validation of the snapshot -> decision on the frozen snapshot. Mutation of the caller's object after validation cannot change the decision.

Rejected and refused with shared_worker_block_unverified exit 18: non-array input, sparse or extra-keyed arrays, missing key, extra key, inherited key, accessor (getter/setter), symbol key, non-canonical key order, non-plain record (class instance, null-prototype), duplicate realm id, unknown schemaVersion, wrong type, out-of-enumeration value, and any record whose two structural reads disagree.

Precedence is unchanged in order and tightened in step 1: invalid/unverified evidence first (shared_worker_block_unverified, exit 18), measured presence second (shared_worker_present, exit 18), unanimous validated absence last (armed). The rev 26 requiredIds exact-set rules stay in force verbatim.

appendText.text: REV 27 (CONF-01, closed per-realm evidence schema): decide() no longer reads realm properties permissively. A realm record is evidence ONLY if it is a plain object whose own property names are EXACTLY and IN ORDER schemaVersion, id, mechanism, measurable, error, timedOut, typeofSharedWorker, descriptor, nativeCtor, constructed, repetitionsConsistent, every one a data property (no getter, no setter, no symbol key, no inherited key, no extra key, no missing key), with schemaVersion exactly 1, id a canonical F1..F21 id, mechanism one of page.evaluate|frame.evaluate|popup.page.evaluate|unavailable, measurable|timedOut|constructed|repetitionsConsistent strict booleans, error one of the sentinel none or threw|timeout|not-created|frame-not-found|unexpected-success-no-allow-scripts|unreachable, typeofSharedWorker one of undefined|function|object|other|unreadable, descriptor one of the sentinel absent or present-data|present-accessor|unreadable, nativeCtor one of the sentinel absent or present|mismatch|uncaptured. ABSENCE OF A FIELD IS ALWAYS UNVERIFIED: a missing, null, empty-string or coerced value is NEVER a synonym for a valid negative; no descriptor, no error and no native constructor are expressed only by the named sentinels. Non-array input, a sparse or extra-keyed array, a duplicate realm id, a non-plain record (Proxy with varying reads, class instance, null-prototype), an unknown schemaVersion, a wrong type or an out-of-enumeration value all yield shared_worker_block_unverified, exit 18. decide() first takes an inert snapshot of its input, freezes it, validates the snapshot and decides on the snapshot, so mutating the caller's record after validation cannot change the decision. A realm demonstrates absence only when measurable===true, error==='none', timedOut===false, typeofSharedWorker==='undefined', descriptor==='absent', nativeCtor==='absent', constructed===false, repetitionsConsistent===true and mechanism is an evaluate mechanism. Precedence stays invalid/unverified first, measured presence second, unanimous validated absence last; the rev 26 requiredIds exact-set rules stay. The rev 26 nativeCtorValue and nativeCtorMatched fields are withdrawn and replaced by nativeCtor.

openItemsAdd.state: OPEN DESIGN QUESTION, NOT DECIDED. The section J browser-identity scaffolding (a scratch executable wrapper used as Playwright's executablePath that records its own pid, start time, normalized arguments and a random per-run identity token to a private scratch file and then execs the real pinned Chromium so the pid is unchanged) is MEASUREMENT SCAFFOLDING ONLY and must never appear in product code. The product-side equivalent requirement is that Falcon must establish the same identity WITHOUT a wrapper through the launch API it already uses, and must refuse when identity cannot be established or any value changes. Which mechanism satisfies that (a launch-API-provided process handle, a CDP Browser.getVersion plus SystemInfo.getProcessInfo corroboration, an executable hash plus argument snapshot taken at launch, or a combination) is NOT decided by rev 27 and must not be invented by the Developer. browser.process() and ps-based discovery are explicitly not acceptable as the sole basis; CONF-01 showed ps discovery finding zero candidates.

OPEN, stated residual, Security to rule. Pure JavaScript cannot distinguish a Proxy that is observationally identical to a conforming frozen plain record from that record itself. Rev 27's position, stated rather than hidden: (a) every structural read is performed twice and any disagreement refuses (record-unstable); (b) a trap that throws, reports an accessor, varies a value, hides or adds a key, or breaks canonical key order refuses; (c) decide() never decides on the caller's object, only on its own inert snapshot, which is by construction not a Proxy; (d) a Proxy that supplies exactly the values of a valid record therefore yields the same decision as that record, which is sound but is NOT a detection claim. No rev 27 text may claim Proxy detection.
